title: On the internal homotopy theory of motivic categories
summary: We develop a general $\infty$-categorical framework for internal Eilenberg-MacLane objects, internal homotopy groups, and an internal notion of covering spaces, and study their behavior under suitable localizations. Applying this to the ordinary motivic localization, we identify internal $n$-Eilenberg-MacLane objects with strongly $\mathbb{A}^1$-invariant sheaves of (abelian when $n\geq 2$) groups, yielding a formal obstruction to the motivic homotopy category being an $\infty$-topos.
